source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Sion tops the poll: rural elections with 96 pc"); Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2 ("Poll surprises in many areas"); Mid-Ulster Mail, 10 June 1967, p. 13 ("Rural District of Cookstown: Notice of Result of Elections 1967")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, checked against the News-Letter and the Mid-Ulster Mail.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Mullanahoe was the only contest of the sixteen seats; the other fourteen nominees were returned unopposed and Killycolpy, which received no nomination, was filled by the retiring member deemed re-elected. All sixteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 10 June 1967, p. 13). McKenna elected; majority 82; 90.5 pc poll.
